input.question: I collect promotional printings and play Brawl. How many different creature cards that have a promotional printing can serve as a Brawl commander? I just want a single number back.
input.evidence: A promotional printing is a printing of a card made as a promotion, as opposed to a regular set printing. Brawl is a Magic: The Gathering format; the deck's commander is the card that leads it, and only certain cards are legal as a Brawl commander.

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT cards.name, cards.scryfallOracleId, cards.uuid, cards.isPromo
    FROM cards
    WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
      AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
),
promo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cards.name FROM cards WHERE cards.isPromo = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.name) AS eligible_names,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eligible.isPromo = 1 THEN eligible.name END) AS same_row,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS any_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.scryfallOracleId END) AS promo_oracle_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND eligible.scryfallOracleId IS NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_names_missing_oracle_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Legal' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_legal,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Banned' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_banned
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN promo ON promo.name = eligible.name
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = eligible.uuid AND legalities.format = 'brawl'

       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT legalities.status) AS brawl_statuses,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cards.uuid) AS eligible_printings
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.format = 'brawl'
WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
  AND cards.name IN (SELECT cards.name FROM cards WHERE cards.isPromo = 1)
GROUP BY cards.name, cards.types, cards.side
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN legalities.status = 'Banned' THEN 1 END) > 0 OR cards.side IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cards.name, cards.side

input.question: Among the cards carrying the boros watermark that were printed in a foreign language, which card type is the most common, and how many of those cards have that type? If several types tie for the most, list all of them with their counts.
input.evidence: "Boros watermark" refers to the guild watermark appearing on cards of the Boros guild; "printed in a foreign language" means the card was printed in any language other than English.

--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -1,11 +1,11 @@
 WITH type_counts AS (
     SELECT c.types AS card_type, COUNT(*) AS card_count
-    FROM main.cards AS c
+    FROM cards AS c
     WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
       AND c.uuid IN (
           SELECT f.uuid
-          FROM main.foreign_data AS f
-          WHERE f.language <> 'English'
+          FROM foreign_data AS f
+          WHERE f.language <> 'English' AND f.language <> ''
       )
     GROUP BY c.types
 )

arguments.sql:
WITH activity AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_rows,
        COUNT(ym.Consumption) AS recorded_months,
        MAX(ym.Consumption > 0) AS has_positive_month,
        MIN(ym.Consumption) AS min_consumption,
        MIN(ym.Date) AS first_month,
        MAX(ym.Date) AS last_month
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customers,
    COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS customers_with_monthly_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.recorded_months > 0 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_recorded_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.has_positive_month = 1 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_positive_amount,
    SUM(a.monthly_rows - a.recorded_months) AS null_months,
    MIN(a.min_consumption) AS min_consumption,
    MIN(a.first_month) AS first_month,
    MAX(a.last_month) AS last_month
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN activity AS a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
